title: Official Tier A Campaign Status Semantics Before Manual Launch

root_cause.label: Loose inventory inference for official campaign status
root_cause.description: SCI-FIX09 computed official Tier A launch/completion from broad completed-result inventory heuristics. This allowed generic spatiotemporal results and dry-run-adjacent inventory to be interpreted as evidence that the official 120-run campaign had already been launched and completed.

calibration_rule.interpretation: Calibration and evidence infrastructure may be ready before official Phase C launch.

markdown_semantics.claim_upgrade_summary: Calibration-level claims are allowed when scientific_ready=true but official campaign evidence is absent.
markdown_semantics.official_claim_upgrade: Blocked until validated 120/120 official report exists.
markdown_semantics.next_actions: Launch official campaign manually, materialize explicit official status report, then re-run SCI-FIX09.

final_launch_command: python -m imputebench st experiment run --tier a --dataset-id london_aq --graph-policy correlation_train_v1 --realizations 5 --epochs 100 --early-stopping --patience 15 --min-delta 0.0001 --min-epochs-before-early-stop 50 --checkpoint-policy best_validation_loss --validation-policy masked_validation_support --skip-completed --progress text --event-log data/logs/phase_c_v2_events.jsonl --progress-file data/logs/phase_c_v2_progress.json

code_changes.change: Replaced loose ResultService-based official campaign inference with explicit official report/status/manifest semantics. Added official source/blocker fields and separated calibration-level claims from official Tier A thesis claims.
Extended STScientificGateReport with explicit official campaign status source, blockers, warnings, and claim-scope fields.
Redirected scientific_ready gate exports to canonical 09_scientific_gate output to avoid duplicate stale SCIENTIFIC_GATE artifacts under 06_st_gates.
Clarified that launch-preparation artifacts are historical pre-launch records and not proof that the official campaign has already been launched.

expected_coverage: dry-run plan does not imply launch
calibration readiness does not imply official completion
official report completion requires 120/120 completed, 0 failed, exact plan match
Markdown and JSON stay aligned on official campaign semantics

confirmation.statement: No official 120-run Phase C campaign was launched during FIX02. The repair changed semantics, tests, and canonical reports only.
